name: coworkos

scripts.test: npm run build:full && npm run check:workbench && node scripts/test.mjs
scripts.smoke:coding: npm run build:cli && if [ -x .tools/node-v22.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node ]; then .tools/node-v22.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node dist/src/cli/coding-smoke.js; else node dist/src/cli/coding-smoke.js; fi
scripts.smoke:multi-subagent: npm run build:cli && if [ -x .tools/node-v22.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node ]; then .tools/node-v22.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node dist/src/cli/multi-subagent-smoke.js; else node dist/src/cli/multi-subagent-smoke.js; fi
scripts.ui: npm run build && if [ -x .tools/node-v22.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node ]; then .tools/node-v22.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node dist/src/cli/dashboard.js; else node dist/src/cli/dashboard.js; fi
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:prepare && ATRIA_PACKAGE_COMPONENTS=light electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --dir
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:prepare && ATRIA_PACKAGE_COMPONENTS=light node scripts/package-mac.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build:full && npm run lint && npm run check:workbench && npm run check:extensions && npm run format:check && npm run check:docs && npm run check:source
scripts.check:ci: npm run build:cli && npm run lint && npm run check:workbench && npm run check:extensions && npm run format:check && npm run check:docs && npm run check:source
scripts.build:full: node scripts/clean-compiled.mjs && node scripts/build-cad-runtime.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-cli-ui.mjs && node scripts/build-math.mjs && node scripts/build-science.mjs && node scripts/build-cad.mjs && node scripts/build-computer-use.mjs && node scripts/build-speech-input.mjs && node scripts/build-desktop-icon.mjs && node scripts/build-pptist.mjs
scripts.build:base: npm run build:cli && node scripts/build-math.mjs && node scripts/build-cad.mjs && node scripts/build-computer-use.mjs && node scripts/build-speech-input.mjs && node scripts/build-desktop-icon.mjs
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run build:base && npm run build:pptist
scripts.desktop:pack:full: npm run desktop:prepare:full && ATRIA_PACKAGE_COMPONENTS=full electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --dir
scripts.desktop:dist:full: npm run desktop:prepare:full && ATRIA_PACKAGE_COMPONENTS=full node scripts/package-mac.mjs
scripts.desktop:pack:base: npm run build:base && ATRIA_PACKAGE_COMPONENTS=base electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --dir
scripts.desktop:dist:base: npm run build:base && ATRIA_PACKAGE_COMPONENTS=base node scripts/package-mac.mjs
scripts.test:desktop:base: npm run desktop:pack:base && ATRIA_DESKTOP_APP=.tmp/release/mac-arm64/CoworkOS.app playwright test e2e/optional-components-desktop.spec.js --workers=1
scripts.desktop:prepare:full: npm run cad:setup && npm run build:full && node scripts/prepare-desktop-components.mjs
scripts.components:pack:public: npm run desktop:prepare:full && ATRIA_COMPONENTS_PUBLIC=1 node scripts/package-components.mjs
scripts.test:presentation: node scripts/test.mjs --build --file test/presentation-files.test.js --file test/presentation-layouts.test.js --file test/slide-review.test.js --file test/vision-model.test.js --file test/vision-pi.test.js

description: CoworkOS local cowork harness and application workbench
author: CoworkOS contributors
